text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having lunch in cafeteria, noticed Agnes Digital
acting suspicious nearby.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Haaahhhh...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san, is that really enough?
Should I bring you some more!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No, this is plenty...
Spe-chan, is your... um, weight management okay?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Don't copy me! I picked that
dessert first, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who snatched the side dish I was
going for! Mine was first—!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Admiration, rivals... kufufu.
Horse girls enjoying lunch together!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*, far too precious~!!!!!
Preserve this moment forever! ●REC, ●REC!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu. To think visual stimulation
could disrupt respiration to this degree.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyo-ooh!? T-Tachyon-san!!
Intelligently s-stunning as always...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We are roommates, and I recall seeing your face
just this morning... but no matter.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, something has piqued my curiosity
for quite some time. Would you answer a question?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Anything at all!
Ah, though I said anything just now—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That shrine altar displayed in our room...
Just what exactly are you worshipping there?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Heh? Ah, that thing!
That is—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
May my favorites be blessed with happiness today...!
Fortune and glory to all horse girls!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uhyo-ooh! So blessed~! The horse girl figures
are shining brilliantly again todayyy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Horse girl figures...
I see... truly an idol of worship.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
When I pray, it feels like I can conquer
any racecourse exactly as I imagine!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Just like all those hard-working horse girls,
it makes me feel like I can give it my all too...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Blood boils, heart pounds, and
power surges right through me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oho, how fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Clearly more than mere adrenaline effects.
Physiological changes via circulation and palpitation... fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What do you say, Digital-kun?
Care to serve as my test subject?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hoeh!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Excellent response!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
First off, let us see.
I require fine samples to examine your specimen.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hold out your hand.
Come now, merely a tiny prick!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
N-Nooo! Touching a horse girl
is absolute sacrilege!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Iron rules! No touch, no beg, no intrude!
Aaaahhh, but stillll!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, calm down.
First, baseline data under normal condit—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
T-Touch... wait, impossible, cannot handle.
That's, that's just too much bliss...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Digitan gonna cryyyy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent! What explosive agility!
Has her physical form undergone mutation after all!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Kuku... This just became immensely entertaining!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Wait! Digital-kun!!
